commands.command: $s=[DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('o'); Write-Output "START_UTC=$s"; git rev-parse HEAD; git branch --show-current; (Get-FileHash .git/index -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLower(); @((git ls-files -m).Count); @((git ls-files --others --exclude-standard).Count); $e=[DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('o'); Write-Output "END_UTC=$e"
